description: This file defines the CommandPool class which manages the concurrent execution of commands using promises within the AWS SDK for PHP, utilizing GuzzleHttp promises for concurrency control.

classes.name: CommandPool
classes.description: A class for managing a pool of commands executed concurrently with configurable options, providing a promise for the aggregate result.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CommandPool with a client, commands iterator, and configuration options like concurrency, callbacks, and key preservation.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise representing the completion of all commands in the pool.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes a set of commands synchronously, returning an array of results with order preserved.

methods.name: getBefore
methods.description: Retrieves the 'before' callback from the configuration, ensuring it is callable if set.

methods.name: cmpCallback
methods.description: Helper to add or merge fulfillment or rejection callbacks that store results.
